items.html: Now, from Netzah of Arich, the right line in ZA was made, which are Netzah and Hesed. And from Hod of Arich, Gevura and Hod were made in ZA. And from Yesod of Arich, Tifferet and Yesod were made in ZA, and from the lower third of Tifferet of Arich, the three Mochin HaBaD were made in ZA.
